mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name AS realName, u.sex, u.phone, u.email, u.title,u.type, u.dep_id AS depId, COALESCE(d.name, '未分配院系') AS depName, u.hire_date AS hireDate, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.expertise, u.bio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessments a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) AS assessmentCount, (SELECT MAX(a.overall_score) FROM assessments a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) AS latestAssessmentScore, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS simulationCount FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.dep_id = d.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
